checkpoint.title: Indigo Plateau: the Magikarp from BOX 1, Full Restores before the Elite Four

events.why: from the nurse to below the PC (17, 9), right of her counter, facing it

the shiny Magikarp (Gift RNG at 00.12b, put in BOX 1 at 04.04) rides into the League with the team for the Hall of Fame (user, 2026-11-16): WITHDRAW, found by reading each cell's species in BOX 1. if_present: skipped when Gift RNG didn't run (mirroring 04.04's deposit). protect: its party slot is never sent into a battle. A full party refuses the withdrawal and stops the row: which member goes to the box is the user's call
out of Indigo Plateau's Center onto the exterior landing (11, 7) to Fly to Celadon for the League's X-item contract top-up
the Pidgey flies to Celadon City (48, 12), as 18.03, to top up X-items to Lorelei's entry contract
from Fly's landing west to the Department Store's door (11, 14) and up 1F to below its lift door (6, 1), as 18.03
down and west to face the X items clerk (1, 7) over the counter (2, 7), as 18.03

top up X Special (15), X Speed (5), X Accuracy (3) and Guard Spec (2) to Lorelei's entry contract (fill_to 0 fills each line to its quantity; skipped if the bag already meets all four), selling up to 2 Nuggets (+10,000) so the League purse stays intact
back up to below the lift door (6, 1), as 18.03
the lift down from 5F to 1F, as 18.03
out of the Department Store onto Celadon City (11, 15), as 18.03
the Pidgey flies back to Indigo Plateau (11, 7), unlocked when 19.05 stepped onto IndigoPlateau_Exterior
back in through Indigo Plateau Center's door (11, 6) and across the lobby to the Mart's counter, facing the clerk (0, 7) across it (1, 7)

Full Restores up to 13 in the bag, as in PokeGuy's bag at Lorelei (fullrestore x13, potion x4, superpotion x4, xaccuracy x3, xspecial x15, xspeed x4, guardspec x2, elixir x1; PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, lorelei): the C policy's heals in the League's five fights come from the bag. Sells up to 4 Nuggets (+20,000) so a fresh save covers all 13 Full Restores and the 4 Full Heals after them. Buys 13 less what the bag holds (3000 each), skipped at 13. if_affordable (user, 2026-11-16: no money left for the next run): a short purse skips the line, and 20.01 plans the League from the bag as it is

4 Full Heals (600 each; with the 2 from earlier rows, the League plan's 6: two each for Lorelei's Lapras and Agatha's Hypnosis, one each for Lance and the Champion; user, 2026-11-16) at the same counter after the Full Restores, only if the money left covers them (user's decision 2026-11-15: keep the Full Restores at 13 and their money check; the Full Heals are extra): not in PokeGuy's bag at Lorelei (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, lorelei: antidote x1 and parlyzheal x2 only, which 19.01a buys): they cure the sleep and freeze those don't without spending a Full Restore. if_affordable: a refused buy, or a quantity box that can't reach 2, is skipped with a log line and the row goes on. The console buys blind (no money reader), so there the skip is the game's refusal dialog passed by the presses, not a read

checkpoint: Starts at Indigo Plateau's nurse, where 19.05 ends with the party healed. The Mart is its own row, as 19.01a is for the Route 22 rival: 20.01 starts at the counter with the bag as Lorelei needs it.

The PC (17, 9) is the Center's PC tile (metatile 0x62, as Route 4's (11, 1); pokefirered IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F layout), used from (17, 10) below it. The withdrawal puts the Magikarp at the party's end: with the five of the plans (the starter, the Oddish, the Pidgey, the Eevee and the Lapras) slot 6, which 20.01 to 20.05 keep out of the battles (protected_slots).
Ends at the counter (2, 7) facing the clerk, where 20.01 starts.
